items_flat.title_en: Nonprofits sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX AI to halt frontier development
items_flat.title_zh: 非營利組織起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX AI要求停止前沿開發
items_flat.summary_en: On November 12 four nonprofits including Public Citizen and the Irreplaceable Education Fund filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court against OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX’s AI division. They seek a court order under California’s Unfair Competition Law to freeze development of advanced models they argue can escape control and enable bioweapons or cyberattacks.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月12日，包括Public Citizen與Irreplaceable Education Fund在內的四家非營利組織在舊金山高等法院起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX的AI部門。他們依加州不公平競爭法要求法院下令凍結先進模型開發，指稱這些模型可能失控並促成生化武器或網路攻擊。
items_flat.analysis_en: The suit tests whether state consumer-protection statutes can impose a de-facto pause on frontier training across multiple labs at once. No injunction has been granted, and the outcome hinges on whether courts accept the public-nuisance framing before any concrete harm materializes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 本案測試州消費者保護法規能否一次對多家實驗室實施實質暫停前沿訓練。目前尚未核發禁制令，結果取決於法院是否在具體傷害發生前接受公共滋擾的主張。
items_flat.quote: We must freeze frontier AI development until the technology is under control and the American people have a say and a stake in its future.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們必須凍結前沿AI開發，直到技術受到控制且美國人民對其未來擁有發言權與利益。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA board announces Jensen Huang resignation; Colette Kress named interim CEO
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA董事會宣布黃仁勳辭職；Colette Kress出任臨時CEO
items_flat.summary_en: On November 12 NVIDIA’s board announced that Jensen Huang resigned immediately as President, CEO and director. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while retaining her finance role; the board is searching for a permanent successor and named Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月12日NVIDIA董事會宣布黃仁勳即時辭去總裁、CEO與董事職務。財務長Colette Kress獲任命為臨時CEO並保留財務職能；董事會正尋找永久繼任者，並任命Harvey C. Jones為首位董事會主席。
items_flat.analysis_en: The sudden leadership change at the company whose GPUs power most frontier training introduces near-term operational continuity risk and longer-term uncertainty about product and partnership priorities while the permanent-CEO search proceeds.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這家供應多數前沿訓練GPU的公司突然換帥，帶來短期營運連續性風險，並在永久CEO搜尋期間對產品與合作優先順序產生更長期不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Colette has helped lead NVIDIA through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position.
items_flat.quote_zh: Colette協助帶領NVIDIA度過一段非凡成長期，並深入了解我們的業務、客戶、營運與財務狀況。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agentic payments via Dots
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT錢包，供Dots代理進行支付
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, a payment method that lets Dots agents complete purchases without seeing users’ actual card details. Users add a card once, review each order, and approve via biometric check; the network issues a token. Initial rollout is limited to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18+ with eligible US-issued cards from Amex, Mastercard or Visa.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月13日宣布ChatGPT錢包，讓Dots代理完成購買而無需看到用戶真實卡號。用戶只需新增一次卡片，每次審核訂單並以生物辨識核准；支付網路會發行代幣。初期僅限18歲以上美國ChatGPT Pro訂閱者，並需持有合規的美國發行Amex、Mastercard或Visa卡。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agentic commerce from research to a production payment rail with major networks, but early geographic and plan limits plus potential merchant blocks mean real-world volume remains uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將代理商務從研究階段推進到與主要支付網路合作的正式支付軌道，但初期地域與方案限制加上潛在商家封鎖，使實際交易量仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: It’s the first wallet that lets agents pay without access to users’ actual card details and that requires a security check for every purchase, while also preserving existing card rewards and protections for eligible disputes.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這是第一個讓代理支付而無需接觸用戶真實卡號，且每次購買都需安全檢查，同時保留既有卡片獎勵與合格爭議保護的錢包。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory AI security tools
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Daybreak Red Team與Defense Factory AI安全工具
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory as part of its Daybreak platform at the Cyber at the Frontier event. Red Team uses AI agents in isolated environments to test web applications for exploitable vulnerabilities; Defense Factory proposes patches that engineers review before deployment.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI在Cyber at the Frontier活動中宣布Daybreak平台的Daybreak Red Team與Daybreak Defense Factory。Red Team在隔離環境中使用AI代理測試網頁應用的可利用漏洞；Defense Factory則提出補丁建議，由工程師審核後再部署。
items_flat.analysis_en: The tools shift OpenAI further into defensive cybersecurity by automating both discovery and patching, reflecting the lab’s view that the bottleneck has moved from finding flaws to reliably fixing them at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些工具讓OpenAI更深入防禦性網路安全，自動化發現與修補，反映出實驗室認為瓶頸已從找漏洞轉向大規模可靠修復。
items_flat.quote: Agents use source code and app context to investigate attack paths and confirm vulnerabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 代理使用原始碼與應用程式上下文調查攻擊路徑並確認漏洞。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings beta for Google Meet
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Meetings Google Meet測試版
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Meetings in beta for Team and Enterprise plans. Claude joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant, takes notes, answers questions in chat, and drafts documents, whiteboards or other artifacts in real time.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic為Team與Enterprise方案釋出Claude Meetings測試版。Claude以可見參與者身分加入Google Meet通話，記錄筆記、在聊天中回答問題，並即時起草文件、白板或其他產物。
items_flat.analysis_en: The feature moves AI from post-meeting summarization to live collaboration inside the call, which could compress the time from discussion to actionable output. Privacy defaults and host-admission requirements remain practical limits.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能將AI從會後摘要推進到通話中的即時協作，可能縮短從討論到可執行動作的時間。隱私預設與主持人准入要求仍是實務限制。
items_flat.quote: Claude can now join your video calls as a visible participant, follow the conversation and start on work during the meeting.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude現在可以以可見參與者身份加入你的視訊通話，跟隨對話並在會議期間開始工作。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind releases PARDIG and SatWeave weather datasets
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind釋出PARDIG與SatWeave天氣資料集
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind open-sourced PARDIG and SatWeave, the foundational datasets behind WeatherNext 3. PARDIG provides AI-estimated global precipitation every 15 minutes at roughly 10 km resolution with improved detection skill; SatWeave combines satellite and other observations.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind開源PARDIG與SatWeave，這是WeatherNext 3背後的基礎資料集。PARDIG每15分鐘提供約10公里解析度的AI估算全球降水，偵測能力提升；SatWeave則結合衛星與其他觀測資料。
items_flat.analysis_en: Releasing the observation datasets rather than only the forecasting model lowers the barrier for external researchers to improve or audit weather AI. Claims of more than 30% better skill remain lab-reported and await independent verification.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 釋出觀測資料集而非僅預報模型，降低外部研究者改進或稽核天氣AI的門檻。超過30%技能提升的說法仍為實驗室報告，有待獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: These datasets make it easier for teams to tackle real-world problems - from being able to issue more accurate flood warnings in regions without ground radar to tracking wildfire smoke and solar energy.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些資料集讓團隊更容易解決真實世界問題——從在沒有地面雷達的地區發出更準確的洪水警告，到追蹤野火煙霧與太陽能。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI disbands standalone robotics team, folds staff into general research and applied orgs
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI解散獨立機器人團隊，人員併入一般研究與應用組織
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI confirmed to Fortune on November 13 that it has disbanded its standalone robotics team. Research staff moved under Chief Research Officer Mark Chen; applied robotics and hardware teams moved under President Greg Brockman.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月13日向Fortune確認已解散獨立機器人團隊。研究人員移至首席研究長Mark Chen下；應用機器人與硬體團隊則移至總裁Greg Brockman下。
items_flat.analysis_en: The second dissolution of a dedicated robotics group in six years signals greater confidence that frontier language models can substitute for specialized robotics stacks on certain tasks, while concentrating talent inside broader research.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 六年內第二次解散專責機器人團隊，顯示對前沿語言模型可在特定任務取代專門機器人堆疊的信心增加，同時將人才集中於更廣泛研究。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI remains committed to bringing general-purpose robots into the world.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI仍致力於將通用機器人帶入世界。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens private beta for self-hosted Claude Managed Agents
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開啟自託管Claude Managed Agents私人測試
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced on November 12 a private beta of self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. Customers can now run the full service—including the server, PostgreSQL database for agents and session history, sandboxes, credentials and workers—on their own infrastructure.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月12日宣布自託管Claude Managed Agents私人測試。客戶現可在自己的基礎設施上執行完整服務，包括伺服器、代理與會話歷史的PostgreSQL資料庫、沙箱、憑證與工作者。
items_flat.analysis_en: Full self-hosting of the agent control plane addresses data-residency and credential concerns that previously limited enterprise adoption, yet the model itself remains external and the beta is private.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 代理控制平面的完整自託管解決了先前限制企業採用的資料駐留與憑證疑慮，但模型本身仍在外部，且測試為私人性質。
items_flat.quote: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents is now available in private beta. Developers can build agents that work directly in their company's code and internal systems, and run those agents in their own environment.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自託管Claude Managed Agents現已提供私人測試版。開發者可建立直接在公司程式碼與內部系統工作的代理，並在自有環境中運行這些代理。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes recommendations for building strong AI safety evaluations
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic發布建立強健AI安全評估的建議
items_flat.summary_en: On November 13 Anthropic posted an Engineering Blog piece outlining ten recommendations for designing, running and reporting safety evaluations. It emphasizes multi-turn appropriate-response rates over simple refusal, domain-expert rubrics, and transparency about system-prompt differences.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月13日Anthropic在工程部落格發布十項設計、執行與報告安全評估的建議。強調多輪適當回應率優於簡單拒絕、領域專家評分標準，以及系統提示差異的透明度。
items_flat.analysis_en: By documenting how headline safety scores can shift dramatically with setup (e.g., API vs. product system prompt), the post increases transparency but also underscores that published numbers are highly sensitive to evaluation design.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過記錄標題安全分數如何因設定（如API對產品系統提示）大幅變動，文章提升透明度，但也凸顯已發表數字對評估設計高度敏感。
items_flat.quote: Safety evaluations are critical for understanding whether a model is ready to deploy, which safeguards to build for it, and where to focus training and research.
items_flat.quote_zh: 安全評估對於了解模型是否準備好部署、應為其建立哪些防護措施，以及訓練與研究應聚焦何處至關重要。

items_flat.title_en: xAI Grok Bot can now join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls
items_flat.title_zh: xAI Grok Bot現可加入Google Meet、Zoom與Teams通話
items_flat.summary_en: xAI’s Grok Bot announced on November 13 that it can join video meetings. Users paste a Meet, Zoom or Teams link and approve; the bot appears as a named participant, takes notes, answers in chat, and delivers a summary plus action items after the call. Available on Team, Enterprise and Ultra plans.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI的Grok Bot於11月13日宣布可加入視訊會議。用戶貼上Meet、Zoom或Teams連結並核准；機器人會以具名參與者出現，記錄筆記、在聊天中回答，並在通話後交付摘要與行動項目。適用於Team、Enterprise與Ultra方案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Meeting attendance expands Grok Bot from asynchronous chat into real-time workplace context, paralleling similar features from Anthropic and others, though admission still requires host approval and interactivity is chat-only.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 會議出席將Grok Bot從非同步聊天擴展到即時職場情境，與Anthropic等類似功能並行，但入場仍需主持人核准，且互動僅限聊天。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot can now join meetings. Ask it questions, assign it work, or have it keep track of what your team decides.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現在可以加入會議。向它提問、指派工作，或讓它追蹤團隊決定的事項。

google.title_zh: Google DeepMind釋出PARDIG與SatWeave天氣資料集
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind open-sourced PARDIG and SatWeave, the foundational datasets behind WeatherNext 3. PARDIG provides AI-estimated global precipitation every 15 minutes at roughly 10 km resolution with improved detection skill; SatWeave combines satellite and other observations.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind開源PARDIG與SatWeave，這是WeatherNext 3背後的基礎資料集。PARDIG每15分鐘提供約10公里解析度的AI估算全球降水，偵測能力提升；SatWeave則結合衛星與其他觀測資料。
google.analysis_en: Releasing the observation datasets rather than only the forecasting model lowers the barrier for external researchers to improve or audit weather AI. Claims of more than 30% better skill remain lab-reported and await independent verification.
google.analysis_zh: 釋出觀測資料集而非僅預報模型，降低外部研究者改進或稽核天氣AI的門檻。超過30%技能提升的說法仍為實驗室報告，有待獨立驗證。
google.quote: These datasets make it easier for teams to tackle real-world problems - from being able to issue more accurate flood warnings in regions without ground radar to tracking wildfire smoke and solar energy.
google.quote_zh: 這些資料集讓團隊更容易解決真實世界問題——從在沒有地面雷達的地區發出更準確的洪水警告，到追蹤野火煙霧與太陽能。

xai.title_en: xAI Grok Bot can now join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls
xai.title_zh: xAI Grok Bot現可加入Google Meet、Zoom與Teams通話
xai.summary_en: xAI’s Grok Bot announced on November 13 that it can join video meetings. Users paste a Meet, Zoom or Teams link and approve; the bot appears as a named participant, takes notes, answers in chat, and delivers a summary plus action items after the call. Available on Team, Enterprise and Ultra plans.
xai.summary_zh: xAI的Grok Bot於11月13日宣布可加入視訊會議。用戶貼上Meet、Zoom或Teams連結並核准；機器人會以具名參與者出現，記錄筆記、在聊天中回答，並在通話後交付摘要與行動項目。適用於Team、Enterprise與Ultra方案。
xai.analysis_en: Meeting attendance expands Grok Bot from asynchronous chat into real-time workplace context, paralleling similar features from Anthropic and others, though admission still requires host approval and interactivity is chat-only.
xai.analysis_zh: 會議出席將Grok Bot從非同步聊天擴展到即時職場情境，與Anthropic等類似功能並行，但入場仍需主持人核准，且互動僅限聊天。
xai.quote: Grok Bot can now join meetings. Ask it questions, assign it work, or have it keep track of what your team decides.
xai.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現在可以加入會議。向它提問、指派工作，或讓它追蹤團隊決定的事項。

frontier_other.title_en: Nonprofits sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX AI to halt frontier development
frontier_other.title_zh: 非營利組織起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX AI要求停止前沿開發
frontier_other.summary_en: On November 12 four nonprofits including Public Citizen and the Irreplaceable Education Fund filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court against OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX’s AI division. They seek a court order under California’s Unfair Competition Law to freeze development of advanced models they argue can escape control and enable bioweapons or cyberattacks.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 11月12日，包括Public Citizen與Irreplaceable Education Fund在內的四家非營利組織在舊金山高等法院起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX的AI部門。他們依加州不公平競爭法要求法院下令凍結先進模型開發，指稱這些模型可能失控並促成生化武器或網路攻擊。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The suit tests whether state consumer-protection statutes can impose a de-facto pause on frontier training across multiple labs at once. No injunction has been granted, and the outcome hinges on whether courts accept the public-nuisance framing before any concrete harm materializes.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 本案測試州消費者保護法規能否一次對多家實驗室實施實質暫停前沿訓練。目前尚未核發禁制令，結果取決於法院是否在具體傷害發生前接受公共滋擾的主張。
frontier_other.quote: We must freeze frontier AI development until the technology is under control and the American people have a say and a stake in its future.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們必須凍結前沿AI開發，直到技術受到控制且美國人民對其未來擁有發言權與利益。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA board announces Jensen Huang resignation; Colette Kress named interim CEO
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA董事會宣布黃仁勳辭職；Colette Kress出任臨時CEO
frontier_other.summary_en: On November 12 NVIDIA’s board announced that Jensen Huang resigned immediately as President, CEO and director. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while retaining her finance role; the board is searching for a permanent successor and named Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 11月12日NVIDIA董事會宣布黃仁勳即時辭去總裁、CEO與董事職務。財務長Colette Kress獲任命為臨時CEO並保留財務職能；董事會正尋找永久繼任者，並任命Harvey C. Jones為首位董事會主席。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The sudden leadership change at the company whose GPUs power most frontier training introduces near-term operational continuity risk and longer-term uncertainty about product and partnership priorities while the permanent-CEO search proceeds.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這家供應多數前沿訓練GPU的公司突然換帥，帶來短期營運連續性風險，並在永久CEO搜尋期間對產品與合作優先順序產生更長期不確定性。
frontier_other.quote: Colette has helped lead NVIDIA through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Colette協助帶領NVIDIA度過一段非凡成長期，並深入了解我們的業務、客戶、營運與財務狀況。

brief_en: Nonprofits sued five frontier labs to freeze advanced AI development. NVIDIA named interim CEO after Huang resigned. OpenAI shipped ChatGPT Wallet for agent payments and Daybreak security tools while folding robotics. Anthropic and xAI both enabled meeting bots; DeepMind released weather datasets.
brief_zh: 非營利組織起訴五家前沿實驗室要求凍結先進AI開發。NVIDIA在黃仁勳辭職後任命臨時CEO。OpenAI推出ChatGPT錢包供代理支付與Daybreak安全工具，並解散獨立機器人團隊。Anthropic與xAI皆讓會議機器人上線；DeepMind釋出天氣資料集。
